title: OPERATOR_ADD_KEY payload
description: Operator adds a key to a key_exhausted session, clearing the predicate.

scheme.description: Scheme tag of the registered public key.

public_key.description: Hex public key: 32 bytes (ed25519) or a 65-byte SEC1 uncompressed point (ecdsa-p256).

signature.description: Ed25519 operator signature over canonical JSON of ["bc/v1/add-key", bridge_id, session_id, key_id, scheme, public_key, seq, head].
